spatialEncoding.principle: Position orbitale → son spatialisé → utilisateur aveugle entend où est chaque sprite

waveShapes.triangle: Convergent — focalisé, un peu plus riche
waveShapes.square: Instable — plus agressif, fort contenu harmonique

content.doc: Audio Synthesis maps Luna's states to sound using the Solfège healing frequencies (417, 528, 639, 741 Hz). Each Crystal state has a matching frequency and wave shape. Spatial audio encodes orbital position: as a sprite rotates (0–360°), its sound pans left-to-right via sin(angle). Distance from center affects gain. A blind user can close their eyes and hear exactly where Aether, Lumina, and Solaris are — which direction, how far. This is not accessibility as afterthought. It is the same state expressed through a different channel.
